source.name: Comptroller of Maryland, 2026 State and Local Withholding Information, Attachment 1

methodSource.name: USDA National Finance Center, Maryland State and Counties Income Tax Withholding (2026 bulletin)

MD.note: County tax on Maryland taxable income, at the county you live in.

source.name: Indiana Department of Revenue, Departmental Notice #1 (county income tax rates)

IN.note: County tax on Indiana taxable income, at the county you lived in on January 1.

source.name: Ohio Department of Taxation, The Finder: Ohio Municipal Income Tax Rates

placeSource.name: Census Bureau, 2020 ZIP Code Tabulation Area to place relationship file

OH.note: City tax on wages. Ohio cities tax where you work; this assumes you live and work in the same city. School district income tax is not included.

source.name: IRS, 2025 Instructions for Schedule A, Optional State Sales Tax Tables

sales.note: What the IRS estimates a household of this income and size pays in state sales tax in a year. Local sales tax is added where a ZIP-level rate is on file, by the IRS rule: state amount times local rate over state rate.

OH.name: Ohio Department of Taxation, The Finder: Ohio County Rate Table by Zip Code

sources.name: Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020 to 2024, table B25103 (median real estate taxes paid)
Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020 to 2024, table B25077 (median home value)
Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020 to 2024, table B25003 (homes owned and rented)

property.note: Median real estate tax paid by homeowners in the ZIP area, 2020 to 2024. The survey stops counting at $10,000: 10001 means more than that.
